112:t_013:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Stay out of my fight with $$アムロ・レイ$$! I'll deal with you later!」

112:t_100:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$! I'll defeat you in your Gundam and prove my own strength!」

112:t_100:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll surpass Colonel $$シャア$$ and $$フル・フロンタル$$ too! For the future of $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

112:t_100:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「If I do that, then even $$クェス$$ will...!」

112:t_100:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So $$シャア$$ really is still inside you!」

112:t_100:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Wake up, $$ギュネイ$$! As long as you chase his shadow, you can never surpass him!」

112:t_101:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain...! The friendly units won't respond to our call for a ceasefire!」

112:t_101:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「They're former friendly units! I won't let anyone who caved in to the $$サイデリアル$$ call themselves the $$地球連邦軍$$!」

112:t_101:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Engage them! We'll clean up our own mess ourselves!」

112:t_102:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$, the $$サイデリアル$$, and the $$地球連邦軍$$...! There's no way a battle like this should be fought!」

112:t_102:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why I can't lose...! I'll find an opening, no matter what!」

112:t_103:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Why...! Why do people of the same Earth have to fight each other!」

112:t_103:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Wasn't this world the result of everyone hoping for the future!」

112:t_104:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「The world was supposed to have understood each other once, yet the fighting still doesn't end...」

112:t_104:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「If the fear of war is warping humanity's future, I'll fight to stop it!」

112:t_105:0.en:
$n
「If they're coming at us, I'll crush them all...!」

112:t_105:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...! $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and the Federation are both Earthlings! This is no time for Earthlings to be fighting each other...」

112:t_105:2.en:
$n
「That's why! That's exactly why we can't afford to lose!」

112:t_105:3.en:
$n
「If we lose, I'm sure this situation will spiral out of control...! If that happens, the Earth will truly be finished!」
